text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Dedicated pool 'resv-west-3' GPU utilization 98% (3m avg). queue_length +1200 in 5m, throttles observed. Impact: multiple reserved tenants experiencing increased latency and 429s. Severity: sev2 — paging on-call.

sarah: I'm on it, grabbing on-call. Raj, you free?

raj: here, looking. first check: autoscaler logs + pool inventory.

mia: pinging forums but looks like HelioBank and MiraHealth are both pegged. I'm pulling per-tenant usage.

kevin: adding context — we rolled a policy change last night that lowered per-tenant eviction priority for shared workloads (was to reduce noisy-evictions). Could be related.

samir: ops-bot shows no cloud quota alarms. but there are 0 new nodes launched last 10m. autoscaler attempted 3 scale ops and got 403 from cloud api. copying error: 
```
ERROR: quotaExceeded: request failed with code 403: quota CPU_GPUS_PER_PROJECT quota exceeded for region us-west1
```

raj: that's our smoking gun — autoscaler hit provider quota. check CloudQuotaDashboard and ticket to quota team.

sarah: status update for customers: HelioBank seeing 5-15s latency spikes then 429 on some routes. MiraHealth degraded for batch scoring jobs. Need mitigation path: 1) immediate customer routing changes 2) free GPUs by evicting best-effort workloads 3) request emergency quota bump + manual scale.

lina_sales: FYI I'm on standby to notify HelioBank account team and coordinate support comms if we need to ask them to fail to hosted fallback.

mia: per-tenant snapshot: HelioBank reserved 12 GPUs, active 12/12; MiraHealth reserved 8, active 8/8. Shared best-effort pool running additional 6 ephemeral jobs. Queue lengths: HelioBank requests queued ~720, MiraHealth ~320, shared ~200.

raj: autoscaler trace: attempted +4 GPU nodes at 16:21:04, cloud returned quota error 403 at 16:21:06. No further attempts due to backoff.

samir: looking at kernel-level logs on nodes — no OOMs, but GPU SM utilization consistent. Noisy neighbor pattern: HelioBank has long-running decoder loops from a burst campaign, keeping KV cache hot.

kevin: can we temporarily move some HelioBank traffic to hosted fallback models? We have a policy to route enterprise tenants to hosted when Dedicated saturated — but HelioBank opted out last quarter. Need internal approval to override.

sarah: decision: override HelioBank opt-out for emergency only, route 30% traffic to hosted fallback (best-effort matching model version). Lina, can you get consent or flag?

lina_sales: HelioBank legal is asleep but prod ops ok to accept temporary fallback if we tell them. I'll call the account PM right now.

raj: operational mitigation steps I'm doing now: 
1) drain best-effort workloads in resv-west-3 (evict policy)
2) mark pool nodes unschedulable for ephemeral tenants 
3) submit cloud quota emergency request + support escalation
4) manual scale attempt if quota increases

mia: evict command ready. Running: 
```bash
# evict best-effort pods quickly
./infractl evict --pool resv-west-3 --priority best-effort --grace 10s --dry-run=false
```

samir: running evict now. will also GC old KV caches on select nodes to free memory.

ops-bot: Eviction started: 42 containers scheduled for termination. ETA 30s.

sarah: spinning up fallback route config: route policy 'emergency-hosted-fallback' set to 30% for tenant HelioBank, 20% MiraHealth. Deploying to routing plane.

raj: routing applied. monitor logs for 504s.

kevin: cloud support responded: we hit GPU quota; we can get +6 GPUs in 2 hours if we escalate to priority, or emergency admin can approve +2 GPUs in ~30m. Recommend emergency +2 now while we continue evictions.

mia: queue_length dropping already — HelioBank queue from 720 -> 520 in 3m after eviction. MiraHealth 320 -> 260.

sarah: good. start rolling throttles on non-reserved shared tenants to keep buffer. Set global throttling token bucket to 120 rps for shared.

raj: manual scale attempted after quota bump approval. cloud accepted +2 GPUs at 16:38:10. nodes join cluster at 16:46:04.

samir: after nodes join, autoscaler rebalanced KV allocation; some HelioBank shards relocated. Observed immediate drop in queue.

ops-bot: Pool 'resv-west-3' GPU utilization reduced to 83% (1m avg). queue_length total 220.

mia: HelioBank errors still at 5% on heavy routes but latency back to 95th pctl ~800ms. MiraHealth batch backlog still draining but no customer-facing alerts.

kevin: note for postmortem — the policy change lowering eviction aggressiveness (deployed 36h ago) increased tail risk. Combine that with cloud per-project GPU quota tight margin. We'll need a guardrail.

lina_sales: I spoke with HelioBank PM — they accept temporary fallback but want a timeline and root cause. Shared their engineer will follow up tomorrow.

sarah: current mitigation complete: evictions + emergency quota + manual scale + routing fallback + throttles. Impact: reduced. We'll keep the incident channel open for 2h and then transition to post-incident thread.

raj: quick diagnostics saved: 
```
Autoscaler events:
- 16:21:04 scale attempt +4 rejected 403 quotaExceeded
- 16:37:50 manual scale +2 approved
Node join timeline:
- 16:46:04 node-ellison-02 joined
- 16:46:19 kubelet registered GPUs:2
```

samir: preliminary root cause hypothesis: 1) per-project GPU quota at cloud level set too tight relative to peak ephemeral needs, 2) policy tweak reduced eviction of best-effort, increasing contention, 3) HelioBank burst traffic pattern kept long-lived decoders pinned.

kevin: mitigation actions to add to jira/incident: 
- request cloud quota cushion +10 GPUs for resv projects (ticket created)
- revert eviction policy tweak or add dynamic emergency-eviction override
- implement per-tenant burst protection to avoid long-running KV-hogging tasks
- add monitored alert when autoscaler gets 403 quota errors

sarah: assigning owners: Raj -> autoscaler 403 detection + runbook update, Samir -> eviction/rebalance automations, Kevin -> policy rollback plan, Mia -> customer comms + HelioBank follow-up, Lina -> account coordination.

lina_sales: logged customer comms: HelioBank notified at 16:31, agreed to fallback. SLA impact: transient increase in latency and partial 429s for 17 minutes.

mia: recording minutes and running quick eval of request patterns to see if reroute skew caused model mismatches.

raj: follow-ups: check if quota request accepted; if not, set auto-throttle earlier in pipeline to avoid full pool exhaustion.

ops-bot: Incident state: Mitigated -> monitored. Next action: create postmortem doc and schedule blameless RCA.

sarah: thanks team. I'll keep the channel open for an hour then move to #postmortems with summary. Good job triaging. :thumbsup:

kevin: note — we should review tenant opt-outs on fallback for emergency only, add a guard that allows temporary override with audit.

raj: capturing logs + events now and will upload to incident ticket.

samir: system note: reclaimed 6 GPUs from evicted best-effort, +2 manual nodes added → net +2 capacity. queue now 98 total.

mia: last check: HelioBank queue 48, MiraHealth 20. No active throttles left for reserved tenants. Shared throttle remains.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged at 2098765432. Severity downgraded to sev3 at 2098765600.

sarah: closing notes: root cause hypothesis and immediate mitigations included. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and an action plan. Thanks everyone.
